items.title: Education, permits, and service training to check before starting work

values: Materials and setup | All fictional, paper and pencil only
Do not use real vehicles, passengers, or lift equipment. The following times, itineraries, and costs are all practice, and the routes do not correspond to real roads.

K1 | The appointment arrival is 09:45. The problem states departure at 09:00, a first leg of 18 minutes, a mid-route stop of 7 minutes for boarding, and a second leg of 24 minutes; no other time is included. Calculate the arrival time and whether it is on time. If delayed, write safe-stop communication and report to dispatch, and do not suggest speeding.

K2 | The independent trip vehicle permits at most 8 passengers, excluding the driver. Station A boards 6 people; station B boards 4 and alights 2; after that no one boards or alights. Calculate the passenger count leaving station B and whether it exceeds this problem's capacity; the total 10 boardings must not be used as the actual in-vehicle count.

K3 | The three legs in the independent trip table are 12.4, 18.6, and 31.3 kilometers; the odometer reads 12040.6 at departure and 12102.9 kilometers at the end. Check whether the two total mileages agree, and do not change the original figures.

K4 | The independent revenue record shows 80 yuan in cash and 50 yuan in vouchers, both valid per the problem and with no change or refund. Calculate the total revenue record; vehicle rent, fuel, wages, and insurance are not provided, so profit cannot be calculated.

K5 | The pre-departure inspection about to be done finds a brake warning with unconfirmed status; the problem requires that the vehicle not depart, that dispatch and maintenance be notified, and that it be restored only after qualified personnel confirmation and agency authorization; this problem gives no repaired conclusion. Write records only and do not instruct test driving or disassembly.
Tasks and outputs

Independently write the K1 time and delay information, K2 in-vehicle passenger table, K3 mileage recheck, K4 revenue and profit boundary, and K5 fault handoff. Each problem is independent and is not mixed into the same passenger trip.

Keep the problem's original values, minute, passenger, kilometer, and yuan units, unknown items, and the receiver; real driver's licenses, permits, road conditions, and safety procedures are checked separately.
Reference answer | Complete it independently first
K1 total duration 18+7+24=49 minutes, arriving 09:49, 4 minutes later than 09:45; explain the delay and contact dispatch, and do not make up time by speeding.

K2 the passenger count leaving station B is 6+4−2=8 passengers, equal to capacity and not exceeding it; the driver is not among the 8 passengers, and the 10 total boardings are not the simultaneous in-vehicle count.
K3 the legs 12.4+18.6+31.3=62.3 kilometers, and the odometer difference 12102.9−12040.6=62.3 kilometers, so they agree.

K4 revenue 80+50=130 yuan, with vouchers and cash recorded separately; without cost data profit is not calculated. K5 that vehicle does not depart; record the original warning, report to dispatch and maintenance, and await confirmed authorization, and it cannot be written as repaired or roadworthy.
Boundaries and review
Each problem is independent; times are calculated only from the fictional given times and are not real traffic estimates. The problem's 8-passenger capacity is not a general vehicle class load rule.
Correct paper timing, passenger counts, and mileage do not prove road driving, medical assistance, or equipment operation competence; real pickup work requires compliant qualifications and training.

items.title: Education, training, and qualifications: which are the real thresholds for this occupation?

paragraphs: The BLS US 53-3053 statistical typical of no formal education requirement, no related experience, and short-term on-the-job training still requires a driver's license and state and local requirements; no uniform Chinese condition is inferred.

China's current 2026 commercial passenger transport rules and taxi and ride-hailing qualifications apply separately, and age and driving experience cannot be mixed across businesses; vehicle and operating licenses are checked separately.
The five paper problems are calculation and record experiences only and do not grant road driving, professional maintenance, wheelchair equipment, or medical treatment qualifications.
Before a pickup, the actual vehicle condition and safety procedures must be checked, and an unconfirmed brake warning must not be claimed as restored through a report or language tool.

description.text: What shuttle drivers and chauffeurs do, how to enter, work risks, and development directions. Based on this occupation's local evidence package and official sources, retaining the statistical definitions and data gaps.

subject.name: Shuttle drivers and chauffeurs
subject.summary: Shuttle drivers and chauffeurs pick up and drop off passengers per schedule or appointment, check the vehicle before departure, verify the route, time, and passenger needs, drive safely and assist with boarding and alighting, report delays and breakdowns, and keep trip, mileage, and fare records. US 53-3053 includes non-emergency medical transport and hearse driving; for China, employer shuttle service, commercial passenger transport, and ride-hailing must each be checked for vehicle, driving, and operating qualifications.
